answer: Propose one paid key per surveyed island station: its lotus-pond and ocean-salinity probes broadcast signed nonce replies in the same surprise audit. Independent receivers triangulate both; proposed validators allow one key per site for a 40-epoch lease and reject reused station IDs. The farm can share a model and rent stations, but k clones require k distinct concurrent sites with two live probes each; loans fund k leases, not reuse of one site. A missing location proof voids pay; a signed duplicate lease claim forfeits that site escrow. Trusted surveyors and receivers are required.
